datasets.name: ODSMarks
datasets.sql:
Select * from ins_dict_marks
order by name

datasets.name: ODSAutoColors
datasets.sql: select * from ins_dict_auto_colors order by name

datasets.name: ODSBanks
datasets.sql:
select * from bankm
order by name

datasets.name: ODSCusts
datasets.sql:
select * from (
SELECT a.id, a.surname || '  ' ||a.name name, a.ADDRESS
  FROM ins_customers a
  order by a.surname

)

datasets.name: ODSModels
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_dict_models

where mark_id = :mark_id
order by name

datasets.name: ODSdrAccessPeople
datasets.sql:
select id.rowid, id.* from ins_draccesspeople id
where CID = :CID

datasets.name: ODSFranshiz
datasets.sql:
select itf.ammount as franshiz, it.ammount as tariff
  from ins_tarif_franshiz itf, ins_tariffs it
where itf.month_id = :month_id
and 
  it.franshiz_id = itf.id
order by itf.ammount

datasets.name: ODSReliaseDates
datasets.sql:
select * from ins_release_date
where to_number(to_char(begindate, 'YYYY')) <= :releaseyear
and to_number(to_char(enddate, 'YYYY')) >= :releaseyear
and state_id in (select its.id from ins_tarif_states its
                  where its.state_id = :state )

datasets.name: ODSAutoTypes
datasets.sql:
select * from INS_DICT_AUTO_TYPES 
order by name

datasets.name: ODSSex
datasets.sql:
select 1 as id , 'Kişi' as name from dual
union all
select 0 as id , 'Qadın' as name from dual

datasets.name: ODSClaimSal
datasets.sql:
select ics.rowid,ics.* from ins_claim_salary ics

where ics.eid = :eid

datasets.name: ODSClaims
datasets.sql: select icl.rowid,icl.*from ins_claims icl where icl.mk_id=:id

datasets.name: ODSClaimReport
datasets.sql: select icl.rowid, icl.* from ins_claims icl where icl.state='Dəyişdirilir' and icl.mk_id=:id

datasets.name: ODSAgent
datasets.sql:
select a.rowid, a.id, a.name as FName, a.Surname, a.fathername from ins_Agents a
order by a.surname

datasets.name: ODSAvalute
datasets.sql:
select valute, val_name, valu_name, valu_short from avalute
order by valute

datasets.name: ODSContracts
datasets.sql:
select ic.rowid, ic.* from ins_contracts ic
where ic.id = :cid

datasets.name: ODSAccessories
datasets.sql: select mka.rowid,mka.* from ins_mk_accessories mka where cid=:cid

datasets.name: ODSMotorkasko
datasets.sql:
select mk.rowid, mk.* from ins_motorkasco mk 
where mk.cid = :cid
